notes.text: This is a wholly handwritten working sheet. The pencil archive number 33 is at lower left and is retained as a TeX comment. No author-written title, date, or page number was identified. Display labels (13), (14), (15), and (16), and the small reference (13) above the relation in (15), are present.

The author opens with Posons and writes three intersection definitions. The E2 line visibly uses Sigma1+ as its first factor. The page then presents an inclusion diagram of closed parts of X, with ten upward arrows between X, the two negative-labelled pieces, the two positive-labelled pieces and central Sigma12, and E1/E2. A lower slant and its uncertain terminal are cancelled or worked over. The marginal NB records intersection and inclusion statements, including a written minus on Sigma1 in its E2 intersection.

The main sentence says the three squares are cartésiens et cocartésiens. An unnumbered display records the E1 intersection/union pair, and (15) supplies two further rows. The right-side live low index reads 22, while the central diagram object reads 12. The relation beneath the reference (13) has three horizontal levels. These are accounts of the written forms; no correction of the statements was made.

The author introduces (16) with Notons que and lists three nonemptiness relations labelled a), b), c). The following line includes an added Prouvons|Prenons and calls the first two relations « évidentes ». The last paragraph begins with the visible words Si on a… and proceeds through empty-set formulas for E1 and E2, then the description « deux partitions » and two complement formulas. The page ends at that stage of the written argument. No independent mathematical verification was performed.

The low-digit decisions used the page’s visible curved roofs and rightward feet for 2, compared with straight short stems for 1. The written 22 was not replaced by 12 from the diagram. The small high ring was retained with circle/o/zero alternatives. The separated three horizontal levels controlled the rendering of the relation beneath (13). The final separator was read from its downward-right stroke. The later complete complement equations were not used to supply the cancelled inline fragment’s missing low digit or a high plus.

The word-ending checks used terminal strokes: les has a separate final extension, inclusion has its final n followed directly by de, and des has a low terminal curve without the separate crossed x seen in clearer deux elsewhere on this sheet. Prouvons/Prenons, the suffix after a, and the final aurait/avait remain open despite the surrounding argument. The peaked accent in dernière is retained with ê/è alternatives. The author’s description of the two indexed Pi forms as partitions did not settle their letter case.

The final period of (15), the comma ending (16), and the point after the parenthesized prose following (16) were read and retained. The commas separating the three definitions in (13) occur in both supplied witnesses. H’s comma after cocartésiens has no separate corresponding mark in the image. H explicitly identifies the number (14) in a note; the full transcription places that written number with the diagram.

workflow_feedback.actual_work: Read the complete brief, supplied notation, packet, C/H witnesses and H style notes, page-specific context and all 23 doubt rows. Viewed the whole image once for layout, then each provided half once and read every word and glyph. Made one enlargement for each remaining coherent open locus. Read all sixteen crops once. No other reader files, other page images, OCR, PDF text layer, external research, or compilation were used.
workflow_feedback.crop_limits: The short marginal lines are upright and needed no rotation. Crop 15’s upper boundary intersects a continuation from the preceding line near the upper cancelled starter; the full half supplied its surrounding layout, and no second crop was made. Crop 01 trims the non-target following de at the right edge. No second enlargement of any locus was made.
workflow_feedback.editorial_comparison: H’s explicit editorial notes were read: its cancelled-arrow uncertainty is marked_in_H=true; its confident notes about overwritten indices and the lower cancelled letter are not uncertainty marks. H’s (14) reference and both (13) commas were checked before describing placement or punctuation. Uncertainty-only agreement with H is against_H=false.
workflow_feedback.return_validation: Checked required fields, unique finding IDs, exact C/H excerpt substrings, all 23 source doubt IDs, enumerated confidence and inventory kinds, and existence of the complete transcription and all crop paths. No compilation or proof check.
